dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL with Micro Focus-style extensions; uses $set preprocess(htmlpp), $set sourceformat"free", EXEC HTML blocks, IDENTIFIED BY clause for CGI form fields — consistent with a Brazilian web/CGI COBOL framework (likely OpenCOBOL/GnuCOBOL with htmlpp preprocessor)

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian logistics/distribution geographic area and CDD (Centro de Distribuição Domiciliária — postal delivery center) lookup utility, likely part of a postal or courier management system
purpose.summary: This program implements a CGI-based web search screen for geographic areas (Geografias) and CDDs (postal distribution centers). It reads a configuration file (EFD90013.CFG) listing geo/CDD mappings, supports pagination and filtering by geography, and returns a selected code to a calling web form via JavaScript interop.

notable_features: EXEC HTML blocks (htmlpp preprocessor for CGI/web output)
IS EXTERNAL-FORM clause for CGI input
IDENTIFIED BY clause mapping form fields
Inline JavaScript generation within EXEC HTML
verdict.notes: Program is part of a Brazilian CGI/web COBOL framework using the htmlpp preprocessor with GnuCOBOL. The 'online-cics' program_type is used as the closest match for an interactive web/CGI program (no actual CICS). Source truncated before end of file but enough is visible to classify confidently. The domain is postal/courier logistics based on 'CDD' (Centro de Distribuição Domiciliária) terminology common in Brazilian postal services (Correios).
